name: termina
description: Hybrid terminal/editor: prompt a pi coding agent in a terminal, watch it edit files live in a Monaco (VS Code) editor, click modified files to inspect them.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:spikes
scripts.test:spikes: npm run spike -- capture && npm run spike -- merge && npm run spike -- session-fork && npm run spike -- platform && npm run spike -- tree-delta
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && electron-builder --mac
